book_cn: 外研社版选择性必修第二册
unit_cn: Unit 5 A Delicate World 脆弱的世界
source: 外研社(新标准)选择性必修第二册 Unit 5 词表(p116-117 真词);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、生态/环境/脆弱世界主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: Few visitors are surprised that the island is a World Heritage site full of natural heritage.
words.example_cn: 很少有游客会惊讶这座岛是充满自然遗产的世界遗产地。

words.example_en: The birds lived in perfect harmony with their natural habitat for thousands of years.
words.example_cn: 这些鸟与它们的自然栖息地和谐相处了数千年。

words.example_en: Penguins and seals were the native inhabitants of the lonely island.
words.example_cn: 企鹅和海豹是这座孤岛上的本地栖居动物。

words.example_en: Thousands of royal penguins gather on the rocky shore each year.
words.example_cn: 每年都有成千上万只皇企鹅聚集在岩石海岸上。

words.example_en: Unluckily, the cats soon developed an appetite for the native birds too.
words.example_cn: 不幸的是,猫很快也对本地鸟类产生了食欲。

words.example_en: Set loose on the island, the rabbits multiplied rapidly and ate the plants.
words.example_cn: 兔子在岛上放养后大量繁殖,吃光了植物。

words.example_en: The hungry rabbits destroyed much of the native vegetation.
words.example_cn: 饥饿的兔子毁掉了大量本地草木。

words.example_en: Digging holes everywhere, the rabbits caused serious soil erosion.
words.example_cn: 兔子到处挖洞,造成了严重的水土侵蚀。

words.example_en: The cats subsequently turned their attention back to the seabirds.
words.example_cn: 猫随后又把注意力转回到了海鸟身上。

words.example_en: The green grass and bare rock contrast dramatically across the landscape.
words.example_cn: 绿草与裸岩在这片地貌上形成鲜明对比。

words.example_en: A single careless act threw the whole island into chaos.
words.example_cn: 一个不慎之举就把整座岛抛入了混乱。

words.example_en: The long story moved at last from chaos to conservation.
words.example_cn: 这个漫长的故事最终从混乱走向了保护。

words.example_en: Experts released a virus to bring the rabbit numbers down.
words.example_cn: 专家们释放了一种病毒以降低兔子的数量。

words.example_en: The virus caused the rabbit population to decrease for a while.
words.example_cn: 这种病毒一度使兔子数量减少。

words.example_en: In the 1980s, traps and dogs were used to catch the wild cats.
words.example_cn: 在20世纪80年代,人们用陷阱和狗来捕捉野猫。

words.example_en: With the departure of the cats, the mice began to increase again.
words.example_cn: 猫离开后,老鼠又开始增多。

words.example_en: The surviving rabbits had developed an immunity to the virus.
words.example_cn: 幸存的兔子已经对这种病毒产生了免疫力。

words.example_en: Free of enemies, the rabbit numbers exploded once again.
words.example_cn: 没有天敌后,兔子的数量再次激增。

words.example_en: The rabbits' digging made some land collapse, killing many penguins.
words.example_cn: 兔子挖洞使一些土地塌陷,害死了许多企鹅。

words.example_en: A substantial number of penguins were lost in that one incident.
words.example_cn: 仅那一次事件就损失了大量企鹅。

words.example_en: This incident made it clear that the rabbit problem needed solving.
words.example_cn: 这一事件清楚地表明,兔子问题必须解决。

words.example_en: This intervention was a long, much-delayed ending to a sad story.
words.example_cn: 这次干预为一个悲伤的故事画上了迟来已久的句号。

words.example_en: We humans owe it to the island to give it a happy ending.
words.example_cn: 我们人类有责任给这座岛一个圆满的结局。

words.example_en: In 2014 the island was finally declared pest-free.
words.example_cn: 2014年,这座岛终于被宣布无害兽。

words.example_en: The island's ecology is finally on the road to recovery.
words.example_cn: 这座岛的生态终于走上了恢复之路。

words.example_en: Producers absorb water and dissolved nutrients from the soil.
words.example_cn: 生产者从土壤中吸收水分和溶解的养分。

words.example_en: The chemicals dissolve in water and return to the food chain.
words.example_cn: 这些化学物质溶解在水中,重新回到食物链。

words.example_en: Scientists can observe biological processes as the species develop.
words.example_cn: 科学家可以观察物种发展过程中的生物学过程。

words.example_en: Shennongjia meets two important criteria for the Heritage List.
words.example_cn: 神农架满足列入遗产名录的两条重要标准。

words.example_en: It is one of the rare places where these processes can be seen in real time.
words.example_cn: 这是少数能实时观察这些过程的稀有地点之一。

words.example_en: The balanced environment allows many species to live and prosper.
words.example_cn: 平衡的环境让众多物种得以生存和繁荣。

words.example_en: Apparently, Shennongjia is one of the most complete natural areas in the world.
words.example_cn: 看来,神农架是世界上最完整的自然区之一。

words.example_en: The vast range in altitude results in great differences in climate.
words.example_cn: 海拔上的巨大跨度造成了气候的巨大差异。

words.example_en: The region rises to a great altitude of over three thousand metres.
words.example_cn: 这一地区上升到三千多米的高海拔。

words.example_en: The wide variation in climate lets many kinds of life thrive.
words.example_cn: 气候上的巨大差异让多种生命得以繁衍。

words.example_en: A wide variety of plants and animals thrive in this protected place.
words.example_cn: 多种多样的动植物在这片受保护的地方茁壮成长。

words.example_en: Some species have survived for millions of years and are seen as living fossils.
words.example_cn: 有些物种存活了数百万年,被视为活化石。

words.example_en: Shennongjia supports more than six hundred vertebrate species.
words.example_cn: 神农架养育着六百多种脊椎动物。

words.example_en: Although endangered elsewhere, the wild bees here are doing well.
words.example_cn: 尽管在别处濒危,这里的野蜂却生活得很好。

words.example_en: These bees have died out elsewhere but still thrive in the forest.
words.example_cn: 这些蜂在别处已经绝迹,在这片森林里却依然兴旺。

words.example_en: The native bees are threatened by the invasion of foreign species.
words.example_cn: 本地蜂受到外来物种入侵的威胁。

words.example_en: The villagers and the wild bees coexist in harmony with nature.
words.example_cn: 村民与野蜂和自然和谐共处。

words.example_en: By giving the bees a secure home, the villagers collect honey in return.
words.example_cn: 村民给蜂提供安全的家园,作为回报采集蜂蜜。

words.example_en: Every spring the villagers place beehives around their houses.
words.example_cn: 每年春天,村民都在屋子周围放置蜂箱。

words.example_en: A simple comparison between the two parks shows how special each one is.
words.example_cn: 对两座公园做个简单比较,就能看出各自的独特之处。

words.example_en: Both verbal and visual information help keep the audience interested.
words.example_cn: 口头信息和视觉信息都有助于让听众保持兴趣。

words.example_en: The talk ends with a short question-and-answer session.
words.example_cn: 讲座以简短的问答环节结束。
